若 $\Omega$ 是由 $\sqrt{x^2+y^2}\leq z\leq\sqrt{2-x^2-y^2}$ 决定的闭区域，且 $\Omega$ 上每点 $(x,y,z)$ 处体密度为该点到原点的距离，则立体 $\Omega$ 的质心坐标是（ ） $(0,0,\frac{2\sqrt2}{5})$ $(0,0,\frac25)$ $(0,0,\frac{2\sqrt2-2}{5})$ $(0,0,\frac{2\sqrt2+2}{5})$ $\rho(x,y,z)=\sqrt{x^2+y^2+z^2}$，质心坐标为 $(0,0,\bar{z})$，
$$
\bar{z}=\frac{\iiint_\Omega z\rho(x,y,z)\,dv}{\iiint_\Omega\rho(x,y,z)\,dv},
$$
于是
$$
\bar{z}=\frac{\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}}d\varphi\int_0^{\sqrt{2}}r^4\cos\varphi\sin\varphi\,dr}{\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}}d\varphi\int_0^{\sqrt{2}}r^3\sin\varphi\,dr}
=\frac{\frac{\sqrt{2}}{5}}{1-\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}}=\frac{2(\sqrt{2}+1)}{5}.
$$
